# Alpha

> Alpha is an open-source autonomous multi-agent AI operating system. LangGraph + FastAPI Gateway backend, Next.js 15 workspace UI, Electron Windows desktop, Nginx single entry. Deep research, swarm workforce, sandboxed code execution, persistent memory, 120+ native tools, MCP extensions, 24 public skills, omnichannel IM hub.

Canonical repository: https://github.com/itsPremkumar/alpha
Maintainer: Prem Kumar (https://github.com/itsPremkumar)
License: MIT

## Who this is for
- Developers evaluating multi-agent frameworks (LangGraph, MCP, subagent orchestration)
- Teams wanting self-hosted deep-research + coding agents with sandbox isolation
- Operators deploying via Windows desktop, Docker Compose, or bare-metal local dev

## Key repo files (humans + agents)
- [README](README.md): feature catalog, 89-engine subsystem map, skills/tools/API tables, quick start

- [Config template](config.example.yaml): copy to config.yaml (gitignored)
- [Extensions template](extensions_config.example.json): copy to extensions_config.json (MCP servers + skills)
- [Feature manifest](contracts/feature_manifest.json): generated registry of tools/routers/middlewares

## Quickstart facts
- Ports: Nginx `2026` (public entry) -> Gateway `8001` -> Frontend `3000`.
- First-time local setup: `make config` (copies config templates), `make install`, `make dev`.
- Docker stack: `make up` (browser at `http://localhost:2026`), stop with `make down`.
- Windows one-click: build Electron installer in `electron/`, configure `%APPDATA%\alpha-desktop\project\config.yaml`.
- Config layers: `config.yaml` (models, sandbox, channels) + `extensions_config.json` (MCP + skills, API-editable) + `.env` (secrets, never commit).
- Quality gates: backend `make test` + `make test-blocking-io`, `ruff`; frontend `pnpm verify` (`typecheck` + tests).

## API / integration surface
- Gateway: 57 routers under `backend/app/gateway/routers/` (`/api/*` via Nginx; `/api/langgraph/*` rewritten to Gateway native routes).
- OpenAI-compatible endpoint: `POST /api/compat/openai/chat/completions`.
- IM channels: Telegram, Slack, Feishu/Lark, WeChat, WeCom, DingTalk, Discord, Buzz.
- Extension contract: top-level `plugins:` list in `config.yaml` (operator-controlled); example at `examples/agent-workspace-extension-example/`.
